name: jira
title: Jira
description: The Atlassian account email and API token a Jira data source reads issues with.
needed_for: Lets a Jira data source read your issues.
justification: Jira's REST API signs each request with an Atlassian account email and an API token. The data source reads issues as that account, so it sees what that account can see.

JIRA_API_TOKEN.label: API token
JIRA_API_TOKEN.hint: From id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens. It acts as the account, with the account's permissions.
